mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) combined with fluphenazine (antipsychotic) increases risk of severe hypertension, hyperthermia, and extrapyramidal side effects through additive dopamine/norepinephrine modulation and reduced catecholamine metabolism.
action: Avoid combination if possible; if necessary, use lowest doses with careful blood pressure monitoring and consider alternative antipsychotics with less dopaminergic activity.
